history.period: 1968 (formal temple construction; estd 1944 claimed by one travel source)
history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: 'Nagamma Temple' is a generic name with several unrelated Nagamma shrines in the Secunderabad/Hyderabad area; the CSV gives no distinguishing detail. This record documents the most prominent and best-sourced referent: the Naga Devatha Temple at Tirumalagiri, Secunderabad Cantonment, dedicated to Goddess Nagamma, the serpent deity. Folklore says a British-era officer demolished an earlier shrine and died within a week; devotee Sree Jayalakshmi Amma built the present temple (completed 1968, renovated since). Hundreds of serpent idols installed by grateful devotees surround the sanctum. DATE CONFLICT: one travel source claims establishment 1944; other sources point to the 1968 construction - verify.
